title: Remove webpack & babel
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Removes Webpack and Babel

Resolves #

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Serves static files using express and removes all dependency on Webpack and Babel.

### :clipboard: Tasks

- [ ] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
author: sidharthv96

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
Why is this `diagramAPI` separate?

(It's in commit https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/commit/a87abc00c65de91ed417e25c5f81973673f21153, which isn't in this PR, so this might not be the best place to discuss this.)

It seems like it just makes the `dist/` folder twice as big (about 26 MB larger!).

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
That was requested by @knsv for splitting the diagrams out. We are still discussing the implementation details.
Let's continue the discussion in Esbuild 👍.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment flags a concrete concern: the separate diagramAPI doubles the dist/ folder size by ~26 MB, implying it should be reconsidered or removed.

thread.actionability_reasoning: Pure acknowledgment/praise with no suggested code change.
